request.spec:
An OPEN claim can no longer be edited; only a DRAFT can, and the edit of an open claim is refused
with an error on the claim. To change an open claim, void it and add a new one. A voided claim now
keeps its number (it is still never reused), and CLAIM_VOIDED carries it.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
An OPEN claim can no longer be edited; only a DRAFT can, and the edit of an open claim is refused
with an error on the claim. To change an open claim, void it and add a new one. A voided claim now
keeps its number (it is still never reused), and CLAIM_VOIDED carries it.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
Open claims can no longer be edited (only drafts can), and a voided claim now keeps its number. `bin/e2e` passes all 4 acceptance tests.

**Server**
- `claim/ApplyClaim.java`: saving changes to a claim that isn't a DRAFT is now refused. Nothing is written to the store and no `CLAIM_EDITED` line goes to the audit file. This covers OPEN, SETTLED and VOID claims.
- `claim/ApplyClaimStatus.java`: voiding no longer clears the claim's number. Numbers still come from the sheet's counter, so a number is never reused.
- The `CLAIM_VOIDED` audit line now ends with `number=<n>` when the claim had one. A voided draft never had a number, so its line has none, which is what the tests expect.

**Front end** (`features/claims/list.slot.tsx`)
- Pressing Edit on a claim that isn't a draft shows the row's `claim-error` ("Only a draft claim can be edited; void this OPEN claim and add a new one.") and doesn't open the editor. The error clears on the next action on that row.
- If someone else opens a claim while its editor is open, the server refuses the save. The form error text now also mentions that only drafts can be edited.

I updated the comments on the entity, the repository, the audit code and `claims.ts` to say a voided claim keeps its number. I added no database migration because the `claim_number` column is unchanged. Claims voided before this change lost their numbers at the time, and they stay without one.
